label: Texas Wastewater Treatment Plant Operator, Class D (Narrow practice bank)
purpose: Practice questions aligned to the TCEQ need-to-know categories for the Texas Class D wastewater treatment plant operator exam. scope: Narrow. This bank covers only the 20 wastewater treatment plant Class D need-to-know categories published by TCEQ.
